meta.title: Lilou Fronteau — UGC Creator · French Riviera
meta.description: Authentic, scroll-stopping UGC for beauty, lifestyle and Mediterranean brands. Based in Hyères, France.

hero.sub: Authentic video and photo for brands who want real, not advertorial. Mediterranean, polished, performance-led.

bio.p1: 23, based in Hyères on the French Riviera. I've spent the past two years building a signature that blends Mediterranean everyday authenticity with modern direct-response craft.
bio.p2: I shoot in French and English, with natural light, and I know how to turn a product into the hero of a 30-second story.

local.lede: Riviera businesses and craftspeople I've helped show up online. Restaurants, salons, bakeries — content shot on location, in the room.

brands.lede: DTC e-commerce, French and international. Product demos, testimonials, hooks for paid social campaigns.

testimonials.note: Illustrative quotes · real ones lock in with the first campaign

process.title: From brief to delivery, in 4 beats.

steps.d: We chat by email or video call. I learn your product, audience, goals. You get a clear quote and a timeline.
I propose 1–2 angles with hooks and direct-response structure. You sign off before we shoot.
I shoot in natural light, on your product, with pro gear. You don't lift a finger.
Final cut in 5 days. One revision included, usage rights defined upfront.

services.title: Video · Photo · Voiceover
services.lede: Custom quote based on your goals and usage rights.

items.d: Testimonials, demos, unboxings, paid-ads hooks, mini vlogs. 15s to 60s, vertical.
Lifestyle, product-in-use, flat lays, mood. For e-commerce, ads and social feeds.
Natural French voiceover. Built for ads and explainers.
Multiple A/B openers to maximise scroll-stop on Meta and TikTok.
Optional unedited rushes for your in-house creative team.
Recurring production for brands testing creative continuously.

contact.lede: For a project, a quote, or just a quick chat — drop me a line.
contact.based: Based in Hyères (83) · Available across France and internationally
